predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines north of Grenada: Saint Vincent, Bequia, Mustique, Canouan, Union Island, Mayreau, Palm Island, Petit St Vincent and Young Island

ledger.x: 27 October 1969: Saint Vincent becomes an associated state of the United Kingdom.
27 October 1969: the UK keeps external affairs and defence.
27 October 1979: full independence ends the UK's remaining responsibilities.
27 October 1979: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines becomes fully independent; same state, same land.

wars.name: Union Island rebellion
wars.outcome: A brief rebellion on Union Island, quickly suppressed; its leader Lennox 'Bumba' Charles was arrested.

certainty.note: Island coasts; the maritime division of the Grenadines with Grenada is not given on the pages opened.
